cohort: The study included 714 women who became menopausal within the 3 years preceding the Korean National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.
finding: Korean women with older age at last delivery were associated with younger age at menopause, while an increased number of pregnancies was related to older age at menopause.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from the 2010 to 2012 Korean National Health and Nutrition Examination Surveys.
